newsitem.title: USA: Omni Multimedia still sees loss $15.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Omni Multimedia still sees loss $15.3 mln.

text.p: Omni Multimedia Group Inc said Monday it will release fiscal 1997 earnings no later than July 24, and it still expects a net loss of around $15.3 million.
On July 1 Omni said it expected a net loss of $15.3 million on revenues of $12.5 million for the year, ended March 29.
In the previous fiscal year Omni had a net profit of $324,000 on revenues of $18.9 million.
The company said it has no disagreement on any issues with its auditors.
